title: chore(pager): define a page size constant
body:
## Summary
Define _PAGE_SIZE = 100 in src/pager.py, use it in page(), and add tests/test_pager.py asserting that a 200-item input returns 100 rows.

## Rationale
A named constant documents what the number 100 means and gives one place to read it.

## Testing
Validation plan: run tests/test_pager.py, which expects 100 rows from a 200-item input.

## Limitations
Only src/pager.py is edited; other uses of the page size in the repository are not searched.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/pager.py b/src/pager.py
--- a/src/pager.py
+++ b/src/pager.py
@@ -1,2 +1,5 @@
+_PAGE_SIZE = 100
+
+
 def page(rows):
-    return rows[:100]
+    return rows[:_PAGE_SIZE]

diff --git a/tests/test_pager.py b/tests/test_pager.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_pager.py
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+from src.pager import page
+
+
+def test_page_length():
+    assert len(page(list(range(200)))) == 100
